% plot_from_csv.tex
% PGFPlots snippet that reads report/data/times_pivot.csv and plots speedup vs workers.
% Include this file in your main.tex where you want the generated plots:
% \input{report/plot_from_csv.tex}

\usepackage{pgfplotstable}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

% Read the pivot CSV generated by scripts/collect_timings.py
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{report/data/times_pivot.csv}\timesdata

% Time plot (log scale)
\begin{figure}[H]
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    width=13cm, height=7cm,
    ymode=log,
    log basis y=10,
    xlabel={Number of Threads/Processes},
    ylabel={Execution Time (s)},
    title={Execution time from benchmark CSV},
    legend pos=north east,
    xtick=data,
    xticklabels from table={\timesdata}{Workers}
]
\addplot table[x=Workers,y=Serial]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{Serial}
\addplot table[x=Workers,y=OpenMP]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{OpenMP}
\addplot table[x=Workers,y=POSIX]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{POSIX}
\addplot table[x=Workers,y=MPI]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{MPI}
\addplot table[x=Workers,y=CUDA]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{CUDA}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{Execution times read from report/data/times_pivot.csv}
\end{figure}

% Speedup plot (relative to Serial)
\begin{figure}[H]
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    width=13cm, height=7cm,
    xlabel={Number of Threads/Processes},
    ylabel={Speedup},
    title={Speedup vs Serial (from CSV)},
    legend pos=north west,
    grid=major,
    xtick=data,
    xticklabels from table={\timesdata}{Workers}
]
\addplot+[mark=square*] table[x=Workers,y expr=\thisrow{Serial}/\thisrow{OpenMP}]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{OpenMP}
\addplot+[mark=triangle*] table[x=Workers,y expr=\thisrow{Serial}/\thisrow{POSIX}]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{POSIX}
\addplot+[mark=diamond*] table[x=Workers,y expr=\thisrow{Serial}/\thisrow{MPI}]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{MPI}
\addplot+[mark=o,dashed] table[x=Workers,y expr=\thisrow{Serial}/\thisrow{CUDA}]{\timesdata}; \addlegendentry{CUDA}
\addplot[dashed,gray,domain=1:8] {x}; \addlegendentry{Ideal Linear}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{Speedup computed from CSV (Serial time divided by each implementation)}
\end{figure}
